name: Pressure Vessels & Piping Design
summary: Code-based design of pressure vessels, piping and their components, from wall thickness to pipe stress and overpressure protection.

topics.name: Thin- and thick-walled pressure vessel theory review
ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (Section VIII) design rules
Pressure relief devices and overpressure protection
Piping codes (ASME B31.1, B31.3) and wall-thickness calculation
Pipe stress analysis: thermal expansion, flexibility, supports and hangers
Materials, welding and inspection of pressure equipment
Hydrostatic testing, fitness-for-service and failure case studies
High-pressure gas and hydraulic vessels, including composite-overwrapped vessels
